selection_rule: Use the smallest standard-library family-current toolchain, keep inherited sealed tools byte-stable, and add only reusable family-named non-compensation tools after the x1 freeze.
planned_snapshot_policy: Fresh additive detached D-drive snapshots with clean Git status, exact commit checks, normalized manifest parity, and no claim of independent reproduction.
compatibility_boundary: The v642-v4 claim-coherence tools and all earlier sealed tools remain byte-stable and are selected only for inherited replay. They are not relabeled as v642-v5 implementation.
draft_source_boundary: W3C DID Resolution v0.3 and JSON Schema 2020-12 remain draft context; the new implementation uses the Python standard library and stable RFC 8785 canonicalization boundary.
